title: Tater Tot Casserole
instructions: Mix the browned beef with cheddar cheese soup, cream of chicken soup, sour cream, seasoning, and a splash of Worcestershire sauce.
Spread the mixture into a baking dish.
Layer frozen tater tots on top.
Add more shredded cheese on top.
notes: From a Facebook reel by Tess Walker. Commenters call this 'tater tot hotdish' in the Midwest. Variation ideas from comments: add a can of Rotel for spice, add a can of French-style green beans, or top with smoked bacon pieces.
